pieces.title: Marble, then the chisel
pieces.caption: Press play; the picture beneath says what you are hearing. *What is real and what is a choice:* Your sentence from the notes, and your notes also say resonance is a boost at the cutoff: the harmonic at the edge runs 8 to 12 dB louder than it was in the raw block (the challenger's measurement). The resonance, the sweep and a soft clip are my choices.

pieces.title: Marble, then the chisel · drawn
pieces.caption: Five seconds of raw sawtooth on a low E, every harmonic present: the block. Then a resonant low-pass closes over it and starts cutting figures. No new sound comes in after second five. The filter cuts, and its resonance leans on whatever harmonics sit at the edge of the cut.
